fearGreed.label: Extreme Fear
fearGreed.read: 19.1 Extreme Fear, down from 22.7 despite Tue's tech bounce (CNN stamp 2026-11-03T23:59Z = Tue close). 1-wk 32.9, 1-mo 38.2. Lowest print in this run.

nbis.headline: [NEW] NBIS Tue close $151.64 (+7.25%), high $152.67, cap $41.22B; post-market $150.76 (−0.58%) at 19:59 ET. Volume ~13.7M, below 10-day avg 21.8M
nbis.why: Recovers about half of Mon's −8.3%; light-volume bounce, still ~49% below 52-wk high $299.86.

nbis.headline: [NEW] Driver: sector rebound in AI data-center names after Mon financing scare; no NBIS filing, guidance change or raise
nbis.why: Same group-level funding narrative in reverse. Price is trading the sector, not company numbers.

nbis.headline: [NEW] Product: live public GPU spot pricing, reserve auctions and a capacity rebate tied to committed usage; AI Builder grants expanded across Europe with NVIDIA
nbis.why: Tools to keep utilization high on a debt-funded fleet; small but on-thesis. Not a revenue disclosure.

nbis.headline: Q3 2026 results Thu 12 Nov before open, call 8:00 ET (20:00 ICT)
nbis.why: Citi $3.5B facility draw, capex funding mix, prepayments and MSFT/META ramp are the tests.

aiInfra.headline: [NEW] AMD Q3 beat: revenue $13.38B, data center $8.55B (+97%), Q4 guide ~$17B vs ~$16.2B est, 2027 growth >80%. Close $483.90 (+3.65%), post-market $508.20 (+5.0%), faded from ~+8%
aiInfra.why: Clean AI-demand confirmation from a GPU vendor; read-through positive for NVDA and for neocloud GPU demand.

aiInfra.headline: [NEW] Arista Q3 rev $3.66B (+59%), Q4 guide $3.9–4.0B; post-market $186 (+9.5%). Super Micro rev ~$19.95B, EPS $1.81 vs $1.23 est, next-qtr guide $19.5–21.5B; ~+10% AH
aiInfra.why: AI networking and server orders still accelerating, which argues against the 'capex slowing' fear.

soWhat: NBIS bounced +7.3% to $151.64 on sector relief, no company news; post-market flat. Real input is still Q3 on 12 Nov.
AMD, Arista and Super Micro all beat and guided up: AI hardware demand is fine. The pressure is on funding, not demand.
Election is the near-term risk: NQ futures −1.4% on blue-wave odds, which the Street reads as negative for data-center names.
F&G 19.1 Extreme Fear, lowest yet; 10Y back near 4.95%. Expect a weak open for NBIS. No trades.
